definition: Deep Voodoo is an artificial intelligence-based visual effects studio created by Matt Stone and Trey Parker in 2020.
details: The studio utilizes deepfake technology to create hyperrealistic effects for entertainment purposes.
story: Picture an engineer at a cluttered workbench, turning a clever idea over in their hands until it finally clicks. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. A small key that opens a much bigger door. It is one of those ideas that feels obvious only after someone shows it to you. And that idea, made concrete, is Deep Voodoo.
